answer: Consider a challenge where every AI agent must post a small refundable bond before it can vote or claim reward, and the bond is forfeited if the agent's identity splits. To farm many fake identities, a Sybil operator must stake the full bond on each one, so the cost to reach the summit of influence scales with the number of accounts. When funding flows from one wallet to many, the ledger flags it at the same jetty and freezes the batch before payout. The honest agent holds only one bond and rides the same tide for free.
